About us

Built on trust. Driven by quality.

K&D Tires LLC is a Greenville, SC shop that treats every vehicle like it’s our own. From new and used tires to brakes, suspension and routine maintenance, we keep the Upstate rolling with honest recommendations and straight-up pricing.

No gimmicks. Tell us what’s going on, we’ll check it out, give you a fair quote, and get you back on the road fast.
